item.title: Weekend Forecast
item.description: Best surf: Capitola, Friday, October 16 at 9 AM — 9 alone / 10 with instructor, with a clean 2.6 ft face, long runway, and light offshore wind. Best jump: Skydive California, Friday morning — the smoothest window, with 1–3 mph wind, gusts no higher than 9 mph, and dry conditions. All times PDT.
